item.title: Joint Statement

item.title: CPI 2024 Press Release Cambodia
item.description: Phnom Penh, 11February 2025-The 2024 Corruption Perceptions Index (CPI), released today by Transparency International, reveals that Cambodia’s score has fallen to 21out of 100, marking a one-point decrease from 2023. This ranks Cambodia 158th out of 180 countries. This outcome underscores a concerning trend, as Cambodia’s CPI score has consistently remained in the low 20s... Read More
